title: YieldTerminal Earnings Results input
description: Pick a data set and the tickers or dates you want. Every result row carries the link to the SEC filing it was read from. Without an API key, only the live samples and the status check run.

endpoint.title: Data set
endpoint.description: Which YieldTerminal Pro data set to fetch. The three samples and the status check need no key.
enumTitles: Company: results releases + up to 20 quarters as first reported (one call per ticker)
Results: every result filed on a day
Outlook changes: by day or by ticker
Dated chart levels: by ticker or day
Capital returns and dilution: by ticker
8-K officer and debt events: by ticker, day or range
Sample, no key: one company (NVDA, WMT, TJX, HD or TGT)
Sample, no key: first 3 results of the latest filing day
Sample, no key: first 3 outlook rows of the latest outlook day

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Ticker symbols such as AAPL or BRK.B. Company, 13F, levels, outlook and capex make one API call per ticker. Capital, risk and events send up to 25 tickers in one call. For the company sample, only the first ticker is used and it must be NVDA, WMT, TJX, HD or TGT.

date.title: Filing day
date.description: Results, outlook, levels or events: the filing (or board) day. Leave empty for the latest day.

dateFrom.title: From (events only)
dateFrom.description: Events: first filing day of a range, with To. At most 23 business days.

dateTo.title: To (events only)
dateTo.description: Events: last filing day of a range, with From.

item.title: 8-K item (events only)
item.description: Only this Form 8-K item. Leave empty for all three.

season.title: Scorecard season
season.description: Scorecard: a season such as 2026-fall. Leave empty for the latest season.

since.title: Since
since.description: Updates: an ISO UTC time such as 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z (required for updates). Capital and risk: a day (YYYY-MM-DD) to list companies with a newer filing.

maxPages.title: Max pages (updates, archive, since)
maxPages.description: Stop after this many paged calls. Each call is one call against the daily limit; archive returns up to 1,000 results per call.

flatten.title: One row per result
flatten.description: Push each result, outlook row, history quarter or event as its own dataset item. Turn off to push each API response whole.

apiKey.title: Your YieldTerminal Pro API key
apiKey.description: Optional. ytp_ followed by 48 hex characters. Get a free key (100 calls a day, personal non-commercial use) at https://yieldterminalpro.com/developers. Stored encrypted and sent only in the x-api-key header.
